items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Sansec reported a critical vulnerability in one of Amasty's 25 patched Magento extensions, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to Adobe Commerce.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This security update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution, and Adobe confirmed it was exploited in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB24-40
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2024-34102 which has been exploited in the wild, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
